title: Lazar's work on power and propulsion in Project Galileo

tellings.quote: to know, like how Bob was on power and propulsion, you know, with Project Galileo.

plain: Between about 1987 and 1989, Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in Nevada, was assigned to power and propulsion, meaning how the craft were fuelled and how they moved, within a secret effort called Project Galileo. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell mentions this in passing, repeating what Lazar has told him. If true, it would put Lazar at the heart of the effort to learn how such craft fly.
